# `@fixtures/multi-entry/button`

Buttons and button groups.

Import each symbol from `@fixtures/multi-entry/button`. Read only the relevant `<Symbol>.md` file.

## Components
- [FxBadge](FxBadge.md) `fx-badge`
- [FxButton](FxButton.md) `fx-button` — Action button. (replaces mat-button, mat-flat-button)
- [FxIconButton](FxIconButton.md) `fx-icon-button` — Button that only shows an icon. (replaces mat-icon-button) → ⚠️ prefer `fx-button` with an `aria-label`, written over two lines (deprecated)

## Directives
- [FxButtonGroup](FxButtonGroup.md) `[fxButtonGroup]` — Groups buttons and manages a single selection.

## NgModules
- [FxButtonModule](FxButtonModule.md) — The buttons as an NgModule, for applications still built on modules.

## Types
- [FxButtonConfig](FxButtonConfig.md) — Defaults applied to every button.
- [FxButtonVariant](FxButtonVariant.md) — Visual style of a button.
